title: my finance/banking simulation game got 63.5k impressions on the first day of its release!!! omg
author: InvestigatorCalm3640
selftext:
I just put the game out and it somehow got 63.5k impressions on the first day, no ads AND it sold some copies

i know 1.2k page views and 4 downloads is horrific even for a $5.99 game that just released but this makes me really happy
